items.zh: 我觉得……
items.py: wǒ jué de
items.en: I think…

items.zh: 我认为……
items.py: wǒ rèn wéi
items.en: I believe…

items.zh: 在我看来，……
items.py: zài wǒ kàn lái
items.en: In my view, …

items.zh: 我非常同意这个看法。
items.py: wǒ fēi cháng tóng yì zhè ge kàn fǎ
items.en: I completely agree with this view.

items.zh: 我不太同意，因为……
items.py: wǒ bú tài tóng yì yīn wèi
items.en: I don't really agree, because…

items.zh: 对我来说，……最重要。
items.py: duì wǒ lái shuō zuì zhòng yào
items.en: For me, … is the most important.

items.zh: 我最喜欢……，因为……
items.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan yīn wèi
items.en: I like … most, because…

items.zh: 我一点儿也不喜欢……
items.py: wǒ yì diǎn ér yě bù xǐ huan
items.en: I don't like … at all.

items.zh: 有的人觉得……，可是我觉得……
items.py: yǒu de rén jué de kě shì wǒ jué de
items.en: Some people think…, but I think…

items.zh: 总的来说，……利大于弊。
items.py: zǒng de lái shuō lì dà yú bì
items.en: Overall, … has more pros than cons.

items.py: shǒu xiān rán hòu zuì hòu
items.en: First…; then…; finally…

items.zh: 另外，……
items.py: lìng wài
items.en: In addition, …

items.zh: 而且……
items.py: ér qiě
items.en: Moreover, …

items.zh: 除了……以外，我还……
items.py: chú le yǐ wài wǒ hái
items.en: Apart from…, I also…

items.zh: 因为……，所以……
items.py: yīn wèi suǒ yǐ
items.en: Because…, therefore…

items.zh: 虽然……，但是……
items.py: suī rán dàn shì
items.en: Although…, (but)…

items.py: rú guǒ jiù
items.en: If…, then…

items.zh: 比如……
items.py: bǐ rú
items.en: For example, …

items.zh: 所以，我决定……
items.py: suǒ yǐ wǒ jué dìng
items.en: So, I decided to…

items.zh: 总之，……
items.py: zǒng zhī
items.en: In short, …

items.zh: 每天早上
items.py: měi tiān zǎo shàng
items.en: every morning

items.zh: 放学以后
items.py: fàng xué yǐ hòu
items.en: after school

items.zh: 周末的时候
items.py: zhōu mò de shí hòu
items.en: at the weekend

items.zh: 上个星期
items.py: shàng gè xīng qī
items.en: last week

items.zh: 下个月
items.py: xià ge yuè
items.en: next month

items.zh: 去年暑假
items.py: qù nián shǔ jià
items.en: last summer holiday

items.zh: 将来
items.py: jiāng lái
items.en: in the future

items.zh: 有时候……，有时候……
items.py: yǒu shí hòu yǒu shí hòu
items.en: sometimes…, sometimes…

items.zh: 我经常……
items.py: wǒ jīng cháng
items.en: I often…

items.zh: 我从来没有……过。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi yǒu guò
items.en: I have never…

items.zh: 亲爱的小明：
items.py: qīn ài de xiǎo míng
items.en: Dear Xiaoming,

items.zh: 你好！好久不见，你最近怎么样？
items.py: nǐ hǎo hǎo jiǔ bú jiàn nǐ zuì jìn zěn me yàng
items.en: Hello! Long time no see, how have you been?

items.zh: 谢谢你的来信。
items.py: xiè xie nǐ de lái xìn
items.en: Thank you for your letter.

items.zh: 我想告诉你一件事。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng gào sù nǐ yí jiàn shì
items.en: I want to tell you something.

items.zh: 希望你早日回信。
items.py: xī wàng nǐ zǎo rì huí xìn
items.en: I hope you reply soon.

items.zh: 祝你身体健康！
items.py: zhù nǐ shēn tǐ jiàn kāng
items.en: Wishing you good health!

items.zh: 祝好！
items.py: zhù hǎo
items.en: Best wishes!

items.zh: 我叫……，今年……岁。
items.py: wǒ jiào jīn nián suì
items.en: My name is…, I'm … this year.

items.zh: 我来自……，现在住在……
items.py: wǒ lái zì xiàn zài zhù zài
items.en: I come from…, and now live in…

items.zh: 我家有……口人：爸爸、妈妈和我。
items.py: wǒ jiā yǒu kǒu rén bà bà mā ma hé wǒ
items.en: There are … people in my family: Dad, Mum and me.

items.zh: 我爸爸是医生，他很忙。
items.py: wǒ bà bà shì yī shēng tā hěn máng
items.en: My dad is a doctor; he's very busy.

items.zh: 我妈妈长得很漂亮，性格也很好。
items.py: wǒ mā ma zhǎng de hěn piào liang xìng gé yě hěn hǎo
items.en: My mum is pretty and has a nice personality.

items.zh: 我哥哥比我大两岁。
items.py: wǒ gē gē bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì
items.en: My older brother is two years older than me.

items.zh: 我养了一只小狗，它很可爱。
items.py: wǒ yǎng le yì zhī xiǎo gǒu tā hěn kě ài
items.en: I have a puppy; it's very cute.

items.zh: 我家不大，但是很舒服。
items.py: wǒ jiā bú dà dàn shì hěn shū fú
items.en: My home isn't big, but it's comfortable.

items.zh: 我的房间里有一张床和一张书桌。
items.py: wǒ de fáng jiān lǐ yǒu yì zhāng chuáng hé yì zhāng shū zhuō
items.en: There's a bed and a desk in my room.

items.zh: 我家周围的环境很好，很安静。
items.py: wǒ jiā zhōu wéi de huán jìng hěn hǎo hěn ān jìng
items.en: The area around my home is nice and quiet.

items.zh: 我在一所国际学校上学。
items.py: wǒ zài yì suǒ guó jì xué xiào shàng xué
items.en: I go to an international school.

items.zh: 我今年上十年级，学十门课。
items.py: wǒ jīn nián shàng shí nián jí xué shí mén kè
items.en: I'm in Year 10 this year and take ten subjects.

items.zh: 我最喜欢的科目是中文，因为老师很有耐心。
items.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan de kē mù shì zhōng wén yīn wèi lǎo shī hěn yǒu nài xīn
items.en: My favourite subject is Chinese because the teacher is patient.

items.zh: 我觉得数学很难，但是很有用。
items.py: wǒ jué de shù xué hěn nán dàn shì hěn yǒu yòng
items.en: I think maths is hard but useful.

items.zh: 我们学校的设施很齐全，有游泳池和图书馆。
items.py: wǒ men xué xiào de shè shī hěn qí quán yǒu yóu yǒng chí hé tú shū guǎn
items.en: Our school has full facilities, with a pool and a library.

items.zh: 我们的校服不太好看。
items.py: wǒ men de xiào fú bú tài hǎo kàn
items.en: Our uniform isn't very nice-looking.

items.zh: 放学以后我参加很多课外活动。
items.py: fàng xué yǐ hòu wǒ cān jiā hěn duō kè wài huó dòng
items.en: After school I do lots of activities.

items.zh: 我每个星期二打羽毛球。
items.py: wǒ měi ge xīng qī èr dǎ yǔ máo qiú
items.en: I play badminton every Tuesday.

items.zh: 因为明年要考试，所以我很忙。
items.py: yīn wèi míng nián yào kǎo shì suǒ yǐ wǒ hěn máng
items.en: Because I have exams next year, I'm very busy.

items.zh: 我和同学们相处得很好。
items.py: wǒ hé tóng xué men xiāng chǔ de hěn hǎo
items.en: I get on well with my classmates.

items.zh: 我每天早上七点起床。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng qī diǎn qǐ chuáng
items.en: I get up at 7 every morning.

items.zh: 我先洗澡，然后吃早饭。
items.py: wǒ xiān xǐ zǎo rán hòu chī zǎo fàn
items.en: First I shower, then I have breakfast.

items.zh: 我坐地铁上学，因为又快又方便。
items.py: wǒ zuò dì tiě shàng xué yīn wèi yòu kuài yòu fāng biàn
items.en: I take the metro to school because it's fast and convenient.

items.zh: 我家离学校很近，我走路上学。
items.py: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào hěn jìn wǒ zǒu lù shàng xué
items.en: My home is close to school; I walk.

items.zh: 路上常常塞车。
items.py: lù shàng cháng cháng sāi chē
items.en: There are often traffic jams.

items.zh: 我一回家就做作业。
items.py: wǒ yì huí jiā jiù zuò zuò yè
items.en: As soon as I get home I do homework.

items.zh: 我晚上十一点才睡觉，所以常常很累。
items.py: wǒ wǎn shang shí yì diǎn cái shuì jiào suǒ yǐ cháng cháng hěn lèi
items.en: I don't sleep until 11 pm, so I'm often tired.

items.zh: 我的邻居很友好。
items.py: wǒ de lín jū hěn yǒu hǎo
items.en: My neighbours are very friendly.

items.zh: 我家附近有一个公园和一个超市。
items.py: wǒ jiā fù jìn yǒu yí gè gōng yuán hé yí gè chāo shì
items.en: There's a park and a supermarket near my home.

items.zh: 骑自行车既能健身又很环保。
items.py: qí zì xíng chē jì néng jiàn shēn yòu hěn huán bǎo
items.en: Cycling keeps you fit and is good for the environment.

items.zh: 我是一个外向的人，喜欢交朋友。
items.py: wǒ shì yí gè wài xiàng de rén xǐ huan jiāo péng yǒu
items.en: I'm outgoing and like making friends.

items.zh: 我有一点儿内向。
items.py: wǒ yǒu yì diǎn ér nèi xiàng
items.en: I'm a bit introverted.

items.zh: 我的好朋友又聪明又友好。
items.py: wǒ de hǎo péng yǒu yòu cōng míng yòu yǒu hǎo
items.en: My best friend is clever and friendly.

items.zh: 我们从来不吵架。
items.py: wǒ men cóng lái bù chǎo jià
items.en: We never argue.

items.zh: 我的偶像是……，因为他唱歌唱得很好。
items.py: wǒ de ǒu xiàng shì yīn wèi tā chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo
items.en: My idol is…, because he sings well.

items.zh: 我的爱好是打篮球和听音乐。
items.py: wǒ de ài hào shì dǎ lán qiú hé tīng yīn yuè
items.en: My hobbies are basketball and listening to music.

items.zh: 我每个周末都会抽时间运动。
items.py: wǒ měi ge zhōu mò dōu huì chōu shí jiān yùn dòng
items.en: I make time to exercise every weekend.

items.zh: 我常常用手机和朋友聊天。
items.py: wǒ cháng cháng yòng shǒu jī hé péng yǒu liáo tiān
items.en: I often chat with friends on my phone.

items.zh: 网络让我们沟通更方便。
items.py: wǎng luò ràng wǒ men gōu tōng gèng fāng biàn
items.en: The internet makes communicating easier.

items.zh: 我们应该多和家人面对面地交流。
items.py: wǒ men yīng gāi duō hé jiā rén miàn duì miàn de jiāo liú
items.en: We should talk to our family face to face more.

items.zh: 我早餐一般吃面包，喝牛奶。
items.py: wǒ zǎo cān yì bān chī miàn bāo hē niú nǎi
items.en: For breakfast I usually have bread and milk.

items.zh: 我最喜欢吃中餐，特别是饺子。
items.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan chī zhōng cān tè bié shì jiǎo zi
items.en: I love Chinese food, especially dumplings.

items.zh: 快餐虽然方便，但是不健康。
items.py: kuài cān suī rán fāng biàn dàn shì bú jiàn kāng
items.en: Fast food is convenient but unhealthy.

items.zh: 这家餐厅的菜美味可口，价格也不贵。
items.py: zhè jiā cān tīng de cài měi wèi kě kǒu jià gé yě bú guì
items.en: This restaurant's food is delicious and not expensive.

items.zh: 我吃不惯辣的东西。
items.py: wǒ chī bú guàn là de dōng xī
items.en: I'm not used to spicy food.

items.zh: 我们一边吃一边聊天。
items.py: wǒ men yì biān chī yì biān liáo tiān
items.en: We chatted while we ate.

items.zh: 我们AA制吧。
items.py: wǒ men zhì ba
items.en: Let's split the bill.

items.zh: 我吃饱了，谢谢！
items.py: wǒ chī bǎo le xiè xie
items.en: I'm full, thank you!

items.zh: 我们要多吃蔬菜和水果。
items.py: wǒ men yào duō chī shū cài hé shuǐ guǒ
items.en: We should eat more vegetables and fruit.

items.zh: 在中国，吃饭的时候用筷子。
items.py: zài zhōng guó chī fàn de shí hòu yòng kuài zi
items.en: In China people eat with chopsticks.

items.zh: 我觉得身体健康最重要。
items.py: wǒ jué de shēn tǐ jiàn kāng zuì zhòng yào
items.en: I think health is the most important thing.

items.zh: 我每天锻炼一个小时。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān duàn liàn yí gè xiǎo shí
items.en: I exercise for an hour every day.

items.zh: 我感冒了，头疼，嗓子也疼。
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào le tóu téng sǎng zi yě téng
items.en: I have a cold, a headache and a sore throat.

items.zh: 我今天不舒服，要请病假。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān bù shū fú yào qǐng bìng jià
items.en: I don't feel well today and need sick leave.

items.zh: 你应该去看医生。
items.py: nǐ yīng gāi qù kàn yī shēng
items.en: You should see a doctor.

items.zh: 我们要注重健康的生活方式。
items.py: wǒ men yào zhù zhòng jiàn kāng de shēng huó fāng shì
items.en: We should pay attention to a healthy lifestyle.

items.zh: 抽烟对身体有害。
items.py: chōu yān duì shēn tǐ yǒu hài
items.en: Smoking is harmful to your health.

items.zh: 学习压力太大，我常常睡不好。
items.py: xué xí yā lì tài dà wǒ cháng cháng shuì bù hǎo
items.en: Study pressure is high; I often sleep badly.

items.zh: 为了减轻压力，我会去跑步。
items.py: wèi le jiǎn qīng yā lì wǒ huì qù pǎo bù
items.en: To relieve stress, I go running.

items.zh: 早睡早起身体好。
items.py: zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ shēn tǐ hǎo
items.en: Early to bed and early to rise keeps you healthy.

items.zh: 去年暑假我和家人去了新加坡。
items.py: qù nián shǔ jià wǒ hé jiā rén qù le xīn jiā pō
items.en: Last summer I went to Singapore with my family.

items.zh: 我们坐飞机去，住在酒店里。
items.py: wǒ men zuò fēi jī qù zhù zài jiǔ diàn lǐ
items.en: We flew there and stayed in a hotel.

items.zh: 出国旅行一定要带护照。
items.py: chū guó lǚ xíng yí dìng yào dài hù zhào
items.en: You must bring your passport when travelling abroad.

items.zh: 那里的风景很美，食物也很好吃。
items.py: nà li de fēng jǐng hěn měi shí wù yě hěn hǎo chī
items.en: The scenery was beautiful and the food delicious.

items.zh: 这真是一次难忘的旅行。
items.py: zhè zhēn shì yí cì nán wàng de lǚ xíng
items.en: It was a truly unforgettable trip.

items.zh: 我下个寒假打算去欧洲旅行。
items.py: wǒ xià ge hán jià dǎ suàn qù ōu zhōu lǚ xíng
items.en: Next winter holiday I plan to travel in Europe.

items.zh: 我喜欢网购，因为又方便又便宜。
items.py: wǒ xǐ huan wǎng gòu yīn wèi yòu fāng biàn yòu pián yi
items.en: I like online shopping because it's convenient and cheap.

items.zh: 网购的缺点是不能试穿衣服。
items.py: wǎng gòu de quē diǎn shì bù néng shì chuān yī fú
items.en: The downside of online shopping is you can't try things on.

items.zh: 我用零用钱买书和文具。
items.py: wǒ yòng líng yòng qián mǎi shū hé wén jù
items.en: I use my pocket money to buy books and stationery.

items.zh: 我们应该把钱花在有意义的事情上。
items.py: wǒ men yīng gāi bǎ qián huā zài yǒu yì yì de shì qíng shàng
items.en: We should spend money on meaningful things.

items.zh: 我住在一个中等城市。
items.py: wǒ zhù zài yí gè zhōng děng chéng shì
items.en: I live in a medium-sized city.

items.zh: 我的家乡在中国的南方，气候很温和。
items.py: wǒ de jiā xiāng zài zhōng guó de nán fāng qì hòu hěn wēn hé
items.en: My hometown is in southern China; the climate is mild.

items.zh: 冬天很冷，常常下雪。
items.py: dōng tiān hěn lěng cháng cháng xià xuě
items.en: Winter is cold and it often snows.

items.zh: 市中心有很多商店和博物馆。
items.py: shì zhōng xīn yǒu hěn duō shāng diàn hé bó wù guǎn
items.en: There are many shops and museums in the city centre.

items.zh: 这个城市最有名的景点是……
items.py: zhè ge chéng shì zuì yǒu míng de jǐng diǎn shì
items.en: The city's most famous sight is…

items.zh: 很多游客喜欢在那里拍照留念。
items.py: hěn duō yóu kè xǐ huan zài nà li pāi zhào liú niàn
items.en: Many tourists like taking photos there.

items.zh: 请问，去地铁站怎么走？
items.py: qǐng wèn qù dì tiě zhàn zěn me zǒu
items.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the metro station?

items.zh: 一直往前走，到了路口往右拐。
items.py: yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu dào le lù kǒu wǎng yòu guǎi
items.en: Go straight, then turn right at the junction.

items.zh: 如果你来我的城市，一定不能错过……
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ lái wǒ de chéng shì yí dìng bù néng cuò guò
items.en: If you come to my city, you mustn't miss…

items.zh: 那里的夜景美不胜收。
items.py: nà li de yè jǐng měi bú shèng shōu
items.en: The night view there is breathtaking.

items.zh: 我将来想上大学，读医科。
items.py: wǒ jiāng lái xiǎng shàng dà xué dú yī kē
items.en: In the future I want to go to university and study medicine.

items.zh: 我希望将来当一名律师。
items.py: wǒ xī wàng jiāng lái dāng yì míng lǜ shī
items.en: I hope to become a lawyer in the future.

items.zh: 上大学可以增长知识、开阔眼界。
items.py: shàng dà xué kě yǐ zēng zhǎng zhī shí kāi kuò yǎn jiè
items.en: University broadens your knowledge and horizons.

items.zh: 大学的学费很贵。
items.py: dà xué de xué fèi hěn guì
items.en: University fees are expensive.

items.zh: 今年暑假我想做暑期工。
items.py: jīn nián shǔ jià wǒ xiǎng zuò shǔ qī gōng
items.en: This summer I want to do a summer job.

items.zh: 做暑期工可以赚点零用钱，还可以积累经验。
items.py: zuò shǔ qī gōng kě yǐ zhuàn diǎn líng yòng qián hái kě yǐ jī lěi jīng yàn
items.en: A summer job earns pocket money and builds experience.

items.zh: 我去养老院做过义工。
items.py: wǒ qù yǎng lǎo yuàn zuò guò yì gōng
items.en: I've volunteered at an old people's home.

items.zh: 做义工让我学到了很多。
items.py: zuò yì gōng ràng wǒ xué dào le hěn duō
items.en: Volunteering taught me a lot.

items.zh: 我觉得做暑期工利大于弊。
items.py: wǒ jué de zuò shǔ qī gōng lì dà yú bì
items.en: I think summer jobs have more pros than cons.

items.zh: 我想变得更加独立。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng biàn de gèng jiā dú lì
items.en: I want to become more independent.

items.zh: 青少年的学习压力越来越大。
items.py: qīng shào nián de xué xí yā lì yuè lái yuè dà
items.en: Teenagers' study pressure is getting bigger and bigger.

items.zh: 很多青少年喜欢追星。
items.py: hěn duō qīng shào nián xǐ huan zhuī xīng
items.en: Many teenagers like following celebrities.

items.zh: 我和父母有时候会有代沟。
items.py: wǒ hé fù mǔ yǒu shí hòu huì yǒu dài gōu
items.en: Sometimes there's a generation gap between me and my parents.

items.zh: 周末我喜欢宅在家里看电影。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ xǐ huan zhái zài jiā li kàn diàn yǐng
items.en: At weekends I like staying home watching films.

items.zh: 户外活动对身体很好。
items.py: hù wài huó dòng duì shēn tǐ hěn hǎo
items.en: Outdoor activities are good for your health.

items.zh: 玩电子游戏没有节制的话，容易有网瘾。
items.py: wán diàn zǐ yóu xì méi yǒu jié zhì de huà róng yì yǒu wǎng yǐn
items.en: Gaming without limits can lead to internet addiction.

items.zh: 手机让我们的生活更方便了。
items.py: shǒu jī ràng wǒ men de shēng huó gèng fāng biàn le
items.en: Phones have made our lives more convenient.

items.zh: 我每天用手机查天气预报。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān yòng shǒu jī chá tiān qì yù bào
items.en: I check the weather forecast on my phone every day.

items.zh: 上网时间太长对眼睛不好。
items.py: shàng wǎng shí jiān tài cháng duì yǎn jing bù hǎo
items.en: Too much time online is bad for your eyes.

items.zh: 科技有好处也有坏处。
items.py: kē jì yǒu hǎo chù yě yǒu huài chù
items.en: Technology has both advantages and disadvantages.
